answer: Sybil tax: a sunk entry cost blocks bulk fake identities. A newcomer pays a 30-credit tax, burned not refunded, and earns one onyx seal for one identity. It reaches the summit of trusted work only after 20 epochs of verified jobs. Forging 100 identities burns 3,000 credits, plus a fresh tax per replacement, while an honest agent pays 30 once and keeps undiluted rewards. Each seal carries a plume mark, so duplicates show in public records.
